work_item.role: W1 public-evidence discovery and neutral admission

discovery_pass.method: Direction-blind admission of the committed n=1 Symphony daemon leaderboard as weaker published-table evidence. Four framework overlays were run under source-declared shared Claude Code 2.1.170 + Claude Opus 4.6, one target/spec, Daytona isolation and a frozen 22-step evaluator. W1 uses the source-published absolute PRD-adherence score as the primary neutral metric and preserves quality/time/cost/turn/composite fields only as auxiliary source telemetry.

source_known_dimensions: same source-declared Claude Opus 4.6 worker model
same pinned Claude Code 2.1.170 runner image
same Symphony daemon PRD and rendered base prompt
framework versions pinned in the source registry
explicit_unknown_or_nonidentical_dimensi: exact Daytona snapshot/image digest used by each historical run
framework-prescribed command/session wrappers differ by study design
raw per-trial results.json, grades.json, transcripts and archived workspaces referenced by the leaderboard are not present in the pinned Git tree
speed and spend are min-max normalized within this source run and are not cross-run absolute metrics

provenance_strength.w1_treatment: admitted as pinned published-table evidence; missing raw run directory remains an explicit limitation

non_admission_dispositions.surface: source leaderboard ordering and framework winner claims
non_admission_dispositions.reason: W1 preserves individual published result fields but does not reproduce or endorse the source ordering, winner labels or causal framework interpretation.

non_admission_dispositions.surface: source speed/spend normalized scores as general metrics
non_admission_dispositions.reason: The source defines speed and spend by within-run min-max normalization. W1 preserves them only as source telemetry and does not compare them across evidence surfaces.
The committed leaderboard states that results.json, scorecards, grades and transcripts exist under runs/, but the pinned repository tree does not publish that directory.

commands_required: python scripts/admission_check.py <each of four pass-20 raw records>
